title: 第15章 瞳孔的力量第16章 逃走
content_zh:
两千多名士兵和两位大队长前往鹰叹山脉，寻找江平安踪迹。
这件事在萍水县引起了巨大轰动。
“将军的儿子被那小子杀了！”
“哪小子？”
“就是击杀崔肖中队长的那小子！”
“这……不可能吧？徐浩可是接近大队长的实力，那小子怎么杀的？”
“话说回来，你们这个那小子叫什么名字吗？”
“他叫……小英雄。”
这件事在萍水县传开后，大夏疆土那边的人很快也收到了消息。
与萍水县对峙的连山县将军府里。
连山县将军孟阔正批阅奏折，听到手下汇报来的消息，脸上出现了一抹意外与震惊。
“这是真的？一个十四岁的少年，斩杀了徐涛的儿子？”
孟阔知道徐涛儿子的实力，那可是接近大队长的人物，在这种小地方，算是天才了。
但就是这样的人物，居然死在了一个十四岁的少年手里。
这少年是哪蹦出来的天才？
“是的，将军，已经确定徐浩确实死了，现在徐涛极为愤怒，派了两千士兵去围剿对方。”
下属十分确信。
“那少年是什么人，居然如此厉害？为何会与萍水县的士兵发生冲突？”孟阔不解地问道。
“回将军，具体还不清楚怎么回事，据说那少年之前只是萍水县的普通农民。”
“农民？”孟阔更意外了。

如果是这样，那这个少年肯定是得到了什么逆天机缘。
“将军，现在对方少了两千士兵，正是进攻的好时机！”手下激动说道。
“不。”
孟阔直接拒绝，“现在就算冲过去，也没什么用，最多斩杀一些敌人，改变不了局势，派人去救那个少年！”
下属愣住，“救那少年？”
“对，去救他！能不能拿下萍水县，就看这一次了！”
孟阔深邃的眸子里迸发出一抹精光，仿佛一只猛虎，即将出山。
下属不解地问道：“那少年就算再厉害，最多也就是大队长级别的，影响不了战局吧？”
他觉得还是派兵杀敌更划算，没准还能斩杀一名大队长。
孟阔摇了摇头，“我要的不是少年所拥有的战力，而是……人心。”
下属身体一怔，立刻明白了什么，“属下这就派人去营救！”
孟阔回头看向身后的地图，“灵台国真是一群白痴，出现了这种天才都不培养。”
一天过去了。
大王山，土匪窝，牢房内。
袁斌看着身体还在颤抖的江平安，眉头紧锁。
“他没求饶过？”
“回大当家的，没有。”守卫卑微开口。
“大当家的，这小子是不是已经崩溃，不会说话了？”另一名守卫小心翼翼地开口。
袁斌摇了摇头，“如果崩溃，他会直接死亡。”
content_en:
More than two thousand soldiers and two captains went to the Yingtan Mountains to look for traces of Jiang Ping'an.
This incident caused a huge sensation in Pingshui County.
"The general's son was killed by that kid!"
"Which boy?"
"That's the guy who killed Captain Cui Xiao!"
"Isn't this...impossible? Xu Hao is close to the captain's strength. How did that kid kill him?"
"By the way, what's your boy's name?"
"His name is... little hero."
After this incident spread in Pingshui County, people in Daxia territory quickly received the news.
In the General's Mansion of Lianshan County, which is confronting Pingshui County.
General Meng Kuo of Lianshan County was reviewing the memorial. When he heard the news reported by his subordinates, a look of surprise and shock appeared on his face.
"Is this true? A fourteen-year-old boy beheaded Xu Tao's son?"
Meng Kuo knew the strength of Xu Tao's son. He was close to the captain. In such a small place, he was considered a genius.
But such a person actually died at the hands of a fourteen-year-old boy.
Where did this young man become a genius?
"Yes, general, it has been confirmed that Xu Hao is indeed dead. Now Xu Tao is extremely angry and has sent two thousand soldiers to encircle and suppress the other party."
The subordinates were very convinced.
"Who is that young man? How could he be so powerful? Why did he conflict with the soldiers from Pingshui County?" Meng Kuo asked in confusion.
"Back to General, I don't know exactly what happened. It is said that the young man was just an ordinary farmer in Pingshui County."
"Farmer?" Meng Kuo was even more surprised.
If this is the case, then this young man must have received some incredible opportunity.
"General, now that the other side has lost two thousand soldiers, it is a good time to attack!" his subordinate said excitedly.
"No."
Meng Kuo refused directly, "Even if we rush over now, it will be of no use. At most, we will kill some enemies, but it will not change the situation. Send someone to save that boy!"
The subordinate was stunned, "Save that boy?"
"Yes, go save him! Whether we can take Pingshui County depends on this time!"
Meng Kuo's deep eyes flashed with light, as if a fierce tiger was about to emerge from the mountain.
The subordinate asked in confusion: "No matter how powerful that young man is, he is at the level of a captain at most. He can't affect the situation of the battle, right?"
He felt that it would be more cost-effective to send troops to kill the enemy, and maybe kill a captain.
Meng Kuo shook his head, "What I want is not the young man's fighting power, but... the human heart."
The subordinate was startled and immediately understood something, "I will send someone to rescue you now!"
Meng Kuo turned back and looked at the map behind him, "Lingtai Country is really a bunch of idiots. They don't even cultivate such geniuses when they appear."
One day passed.
Dawang Mountain, bandit den, inside the prison cell.
Yuan Bin looked at Jiang Ping'an, whose body was still trembling, and frowned.
"He never begged for mercy?"
"There is no one who has returned to the head of the family." The guard said humbly.
"Master, has this kid collapsed and can't speak?" Another guard said cautiously.
Yuan Bin shook his head, "If it collapses, he will die directly."
